name: Bryce Mitchell

official.division_note: Moved from featherweight to bantamweight; submitted Santiago Luna at bantamweight at UFC Vegas 118 (Jun 6, 2026).

photo_coverage: Good; 10 photos, all reference-only: the Commons search and category for him returned nothing, so there is no embed-ok photo. Front: ESPN studio headshot (Jun 2026), Jun 2026 media day and post-fight press conference. Three-quarter: Apr 2025 press conference and official weigh-in. Profile: Jul 2025 and Jun 2026 faceoffs (both his right side; glasses in 2026). Physique: ESPN cutouts (Dec 2023, Jun 2026) and the Apr 2025 ceremonial weigh-in.

face.shape: Oval, slightly long, widest at the cheekbones and tapering to a narrow, beard-covered chin (a mild inverted triangle). Lean, with little facial fat.
face.jaw: Narrow to medium, lightly defined under the beard; the jaw line rises steeply from chin to ear.
face.chin: Narrow and slightly pointed, medium height; covered by the beard.
face.cheekbones: Moderately high, not very prominent; flat cheeks below.
face.brow_ridge: Mild; the brows sit fairly low and straight.
face.forehead: Medium height, mostly covered by a short fringe; a faint horizontal line or two.

eyes.shape: Almond to slightly round, open, with a visible upper-lid crease; level outer corners, light lashes.
eyes.colour: Light blue (blue-grey). Closest embed iris: blue.

eyebrows.shape: Straight, low and fairly level, slightly heavier at the inner ends; light colour makes them read faint.

nose.bridge: Straight and narrow from the front.
nose.hump: None; straight to very slightly concave in the July 2025 right-side profile.
nose.tip: Rounded, slightly upturned to level; medium nostrils.

face.mouth_lips: Medium-narrow mouth; thin upper lip, medium lower lip, mostly hidden by the moustache. Broad, toothy grin when smiling (2025 and 2026 media).

ears.protrusion: Stand out slightly, the left a little more in the studio headshot.
ears.cauliflower_ear: No clear cauliflower ear visible; ear folds look normal at this resolution (medium confidence).

face.notable_marks_scars: None obvious. Face and neck flush red easily (post-fight June 2026 photo).

hair.style: Short textured crop: about 5 cm on top pushed forward into a short, choppy fringe over the forehead, shorter (about 1.5 cm) tapered sides and back (June 2026 studio shoot; similar in December 2023 and April 2025).
hair.colour: Light to medium brown with a reddish-golden tint and lighter, sun-lightened tips.
hair.colour_samples_note: The top of the head sits in shadow in the studio light; the fringe tips (where light passes through) show the true lighter colour. colour_hex is a judged mid value.
hair.hairline: Straight, fairly low, mostly hidden by the fringe.
hair.texture: Fine to medium, straight, slightly piecey.

facial_hair.colour: Ginger / auburn brown, redder than the head hair.
facial_hair.density: Dense on the moustache and chin, medium on the jaw, thinner on the upper cheeks.
facial_hair.shape: Full short beard joined to the moustache; low, natural cheek line; rounded at the chin; neckline under the jaw.

tone_samples.light: press-room light (face flushed after the fight, not sampled)

skin.tone_note: Each sample is the median of a box on well-lit skin (box in source pixels). Studio ESPN files are high-key and warm; the post-fight face is flushed red (#bd6953 forehead), so only his chest was sampled there. The 2026 media-day highlight on his left cheek (#eeba9f) was left out as a specular highlight.
skin.undertone: Warm-pink (ruddy): flushes red on the face, neck and chest; light golden tan on the arms.
skin.freckles_marks: No distinct freckles visible at these resolutions; ruddy cheeks and nose; light reddish body hair.

body.build: Lean and long-limbed for 135 lb (178 cm, 178 cm reach); narrow frame.
body.body_fat_notes: Low body fat with soft-edged definition: abs outlined but not deeply cut in the 2025 and 2026 photos; smooth, not vascular.
body.arms: Long, lean arms with modest biceps; slim forearms.
body.legs_calves: Long legs with slim thighs and slim calves.
body.posture: Relaxed, slightly hunched shoulders when standing; head carried a little forward.
body.notable_physique_traits: Pale, lean, long-limbed grappler's body; reddish beard and fringe; no tattoos on the front. Light body hair on chest and legs.

tattoos.description: None visible on the chest, abdomen, arms or legs in the front-facing studio cutouts (2023, 2026) or the 2025-2026 weigh-in and press photos. Back not seen clearly.

accessories_seen: Beaded necklace (white, red, blue and black beads) with two claw- or tusk-shaped pendants at the July 2025 faceoff and June 2026 post-fight presser; thin dark-rimmed rectangular glasses at the June 2026 weigh-in faceoff.

kit.typical_shorts: UFC fight-kit shorts in a woodland / hunting-camouflage print (browns, tan leaves, dark bark) with black side panels and white stripes, MITCHELL down the left leg, cut longer than most; worn in the December 2023 and June 2026 studio shoots. Fight-night colour follows the corner.

render_hints.skin_base: mh-skin-young_caucasian_male tinted toward the tone_hex, with extra red on the cheeks, nose and neck
render_hints.hair: cortu_short_messy_hair or short02 with a short forward fringe, tinted #5e4030 (lighter tips)
render_hints.beard: short full beard #7d4a33 (ginger), redder than the hair

stance.source: data/scouting/bryce-mitchell.json (archetype grappler/BJJ, southpaw; long top-control rides; southpaw kicks to legs and body at range; low striking output) plus general knowledge of his fight footage. Not measured from these photos.
stance.notes: Southpaw grappler: moderately crouched, square enough to change levels, lead hand busy reaching and pawing; walks forward behind kicks looking for the clinch or a shot. Little head movement.

notes: Confidence: high for colouring (light-blue eyes, light-brown hair with lighter tips, ginger beard, fair ruddy skin) and build; medium for face proportions; medium-low for the morph values. What to watch: (1) light-blue eyes and a ginger/auburn short full beard that is redder than the light-brown hair; (2) short, choppy fringe pushed forward over the forehead; (3) fair skin that flushes red on the face and neck; (4) oval face tapering to a narrow bearded chin; (5) narrow, lean, smooth body with long limbs and no tattoos; (6) the beaded claw-pendant necklace and glasses are off-duty accessories, not fight-night kit. He now fights at bantamweight (135 lb). The stance block comes from data/scouting and general fight-footage knowledge, not from these photos. ageOldM uses (years-25)/65; l-/r- values are symmetric.
